svg.text: Copy on one device, paste on another. Everything is encrypted on your device before it leaves; the relay only ever sees ciphertext.
Accounts = vaults. Same passphrase → same vault. A different passphrase → a separate vault that cannot see the first.
Reads/writes the clipboard via built-in PowerShell
Open app to see + copy items; auto-copy when focused

Same passphrase in both → they share a vault.

Plain text exists only on your devices. Passphrase never leaves the device · server sees ciphertext, timestamps, sizes · a device ignores what it just received (no ping-pong).

Start the relay first: npm start (or docker build -t uclip . && docker run -p 8787:8787 uclip), behind HTTPS. First device: uclip init prints a new passphrase; reuse it on every other device.
